subtitle: דלאלהֵ אלחאירין — The Guide of the Perplexed
author: Moses Maimonides (1138–1204)
intro: A short note on the noun adam, which is used in three ways: as the proper name of the first man (derived from adamah, 'earth'); as the name of the human species ('My spirit shall not abide in man'); and as a name for the common people, as opposed to the elite ('both the sons of adam and the sons of ish'). Hover a phrase to see its English light up; tap any word for a gloss; dotted words are key terms.

terms.note: Three senses: (1) the proper name of the first man, derived from adamah ('earth'); (2) the human species; (3) the common people, set against b'nei ish, the elite.
The text itself derives the name Adam from adamah, the earth from which he was formed — the etymology behind the proper-name sense.

terms.gloss: the common people as opposed to the elite
terms.note: The third sense of adam: the multitude, distinguished from b'nei ish, 'the sons of ish' — the elite. The contrast 'both the sons of adam and the sons of ish' turns on this.

aligned.ja: אלג'ז אלאול · אלפצל אלראבע עשר — אדם
אשתראך אדם. הוא אסם אדם הראשון, משתק כמא ג'א אלנץ אנה משתק מן אדמה.
aligned.en: The equivocity of adam. It is the name of Adam the first man, derived — as the text states that it is derived — from adamah ('earth').

pairs.en: It is the name of Adam the first man

pairs.ja: משתק כמא ג'א אלנץ אנה משתק מן אדמה
pairs.en: derived — as the text states that it is derived — from adamah ('earth')

aligned.ja: ויכון אסם אלנוע: לא ידון רוחי באדם, מי יודע רוח בני האדם, ומותר האדם מן הבהמה אין.
aligned.en: And it is the name of the species: 'My spirit shall not abide in man' (Gen 6:3); 'who knows the spirit of the sons of man' (Eccl 3:21); 'and the pre-eminence of man over beast is naught' (Eccl 3:19).

pairs.en: And it is the name of the species
My spirit shall not abide in man
who knows the spirit of the sons of man
and the pre-eminence of man over beast is naught

aligned.ja: ויכון אסמא ללג'מהור, אעני ללעאמה דון אלכ'אצה: גם בני אדם גם בני איש.
aligned.en: And it is a name for the multitude — I mean for the common people as opposed to the elite: 'both the sons of adam and the sons of ish' (Ps 49:3).

pairs.en: And it is a name for the multitude
I mean for the common people as opposed to the elite

pairs.ja: גם בני אדם גם בני איש
pairs.en: both the sons of adam and the sons of ish

aligned.ja: ומן הד'א אלמעני אלת'אלת': ויראו בני האלהים את בנות האדם, אכן כאדם תמותון.
aligned.en: And of this third sense: 'and the sons of God saw the daughters of man' (Gen 6:2); 'surely you shall die like adam' (Ps 82:7).

pairs.ja: ויראו בני האלהים את בנות האדם
pairs.en: and the sons of God saw the daughters of man
surely you shall die like adam
